source: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance, WRS-2 path 160 row 043
attribution: Landsat 8-9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey. Accessed via Microsoft Planetary Computer.
method: MNDWI change from 2024-03-18 to 2024-04-19, threshold +0.15; permanent water excluded via QA_PIXEL water flag set on both baseline and recovery
limitation: Observed 3 days after the rain, not at peak; the model reports peak depth. At 30 m, water in streets between buildings is sub-pixel — published work on this event used 3 m PlanetScope with a trained classifier. Baseline is Landsat 8 OLI, flood is Landsat 9 OLI-2; Collection 2 harmonises them but a residual cross-sensor bias is possible. A low agreement score is therefore ambiguous between model error and sensor limit — the recovery scene is what separates them.
